compatibilityPolicy: strict pre-1.0 SemVer: a published PATCH release must not hide an incompatible change
termRegistry: Section 18.3 of the published specification defines the term-registry contract; vocab/kee.ttl is its published declaration document.

nonCollapseBehaviouralCoverage.reason: representational: accountability and trust are not represented as surfaces distinct from authority and confidence

profileLifecycleNamespaceNote: https://w3id.org/kee/lifecycle/governance-record# is the governance-record review-status scheme (Section 9.2): owned by the Governance Transition Profile and adopted for kee:lifecycleState on kee:GovernanceTransitionRecord, kee:ContradictionRecord, kee:ContestedAuthorityClaim and kee:LifecycleCrosswalkMapping; not adopted for kee:AssertionMetadataRecord, whose slot carries the managed unit's lifecycle (Section 16.4). Added at 0.11.0; registration pending.

localVocabularyNamespaces.https://w3id.org/kee/vocab/query-time-di: closed slot (kee:queryTimeDimension), two concepts; Sections 10, 14.2; added at 0.11.0; registration pending
localVocabularyNamespaces.https://w3id.org/kee/vocab/retrieval-eli: closed slot (kee:eligibilityCategory), seven concepts; Sections 10, 14.5; added at 0.11.0; registration pending

registeredLegacyCompatibilityWindow.legacyReads: only where the migration registry explicitly records a compatibility policy
registeredLegacyCompatibilityWindow.retirement: requires a separately versioned decision and migration notice naming the legacy surface, last dual-read version, first rejecting version, and migration path or explicit absence of a safe automatic migration

sharedContractCount: NOT PUBLISHED. The question-(a) figure is carried as a band after the classification predicate failed blind replication, and must not be narrowed by drafting alone. No count is part of this API.
openItems: shared-contract band not settled; no drafting-only narrowing authorized
KEEpack Experimental / Non-Normative pending independent producer/consumer evidence

the governance-record review-status check reports at sh:Warning at this release and at sh:Violation from 0.12.0, the first rejecting version; whether the Assertion Metadata lifecycle slot will ever reject a generic or mixed-axis value is undecided

verified 2026-10-12: the base w3id identifier content-negotiates; the artifact, confidence, five lifecycle and two local-vocabulary namespaces that 0.10.0 carried resolve to their concept schemes by an unconditional redirect, served as text/plain; the generic lifecycle namespace and the Section 5 profile identifiers resolve to human-readable pages; the three namespaces added at this release are registration pending and do not resolve; durable persistence of any resolving identifier is not thereby established; and the version-identifier redirect rules are not yet registered
shapeGraphNote: The published shape graphs are byte-identical to those the reference validator executes. A structural result from a Draft or Non-Normative shape has no normative effect.

conformanceBehaviourChanges.constraint: kee:lifecycleState on a governance record is a concept of the governance-record review-status scheme
conformanceBehaviourChanges.severityBefore: none: no membership check existed under 0.10.0
conformanceBehaviourChanges.owningProfile: Governance Transition (owner); Contradiction Records, Authority and Delegation, Lifecycle Crosswalk (adopting)
conformanceBehaviourChanges.classification: MINOR-compatible because the owning profiles are excluded from the public normative API; no conformance outcome changes at 0.11.0

negativeCase.case: a record of one of the four classes whose kee:lifecycleState is a generic https://w3id.org/kee/lifecycle# value rather than Proposed, Accepted, Rejected, Withdrawn or Superseded

conformanceBehaviourChanges.migrationObligation: Implementations claiming any of the four profiles write the review status of a governance record from the governance-record review-status scheme; a generic value is reported at 0.11.0 and rejected from 0.12.0. No generic value maps to a scheme concept.

conformanceBehaviourChanges.constraint: kee:queryTimeDimension on a new-write point-in-time query record is a concept of the query-time-dimension scheme; kee:eligibilityCategory on a new-write retrieval result is a concept of the retrieval-eligibility scheme
conformanceBehaviourChanges.severityBefore: none in the shape graphs 0.10.0 published, whose slot was an open IRI; sh:Warning in the staged value shapes the repository carried under the 0.10.0 baseline
conformanceBehaviourChanges.legacyBranch: a record declaring only kee:profileConformance is reported at sh:Warning and remains readable for as long as that carrier is; it retires with the carrier
conformanceBehaviourChanges.owningProfile: Historical and Bitemporal Querying; AI-Grounded Retrieval
conformanceBehaviourChanges.classification: MINOR-compatible because the owning profiles are excluded from the public normative API

negativeCase.case: a new-write point-in-time query record or retrieval result (dcterms:conformsTo, or no conformance carrier) whose value in the closed slot is an IRI outside the scheme

conformanceBehaviourChanges.migrationObligation: Implementations claiming either profile write kee:queryTimeDimension as qtd:RecordedTime or qtd:ValidTime, and kee:eligibilityCategory as one of the seven retrieval-eligibility concepts. No automatic mapping from a producer-minted identifier to a scheme concept is defined; a registered-legacy record is reported, not rewritten.

conformanceBehaviourChanges.constraint: kee:lifecycleState on an Assertion Metadata record is neither a generic https://w3id.org/kee/lifecycle# value nor a dispute, ranking or assessment standing (kee:ChallengedAssertion, kee:SupersededAssertion, kee:PreferredAssertion, kee:QualifiedAssertion)
conformanceBehaviourChanges.severityBefore: none: no such check existed in the shape graphs 0.10.0 published
conformanceBehaviourChanges.rejection: not scheduled: whether and when the profile rejects such a value is a separately versioned decision with its own migration notice (Section 17.3), not yet taken
conformanceBehaviourChanges.classification: MINOR-compatible because the shape reports and rejects nothing: no conformance outcome changes and the profile's public contract is unchanged

negativeCase.case: an Assertion Metadata record whose kee:lifecycleState is a generic https://w3id.org/kee/lifecycle# value, or kee:ChallengedAssertion, kee:SupersededAssertion, kee:PreferredAssertion or kee:QualifiedAssertion

conformanceBehaviourChanges.migrationObligation: None at this release: new writes use the lifecycle scheme of the profile governing the managed unit, https://w3id.org/kee/lifecycle/assertion# when no other profile does; a generic or mixed-axis value is reported, not rejected.
